Brief Hospital Course:
Assessment and Plan: This is a ___ yo F with polcystic kidney

# ESRD/HD initiation: The patient was admitted for dialysis 
initiation.  She tolerated 3 session of hemodialysis without any 
complication during this admission.  She had a PPD placed and 
should be read at her PCP's office on ___.  
Several medications were changed in accordance with her 
intiation of HD.  We stopped hectorol, iron supplementation, and 
aranesp.  We started nephrocaps.   Hep B and C serologies were 
obtained and were negative.
.  
# Hypertension: Valsartan and atenolol were discontinued this 
admission as the patient's hypertension improved with initiation 
of HD.  Amlodipine and lisinopril were continued. 
.  
# Afib: Pt was in sinus bradycardia with heart rate in the low 
___ likely secondary to use of atenolol in the setting of renal 
failure.  Atenolol discontinued.  Pt will need HR monitored 
closely after discharge.  Continue coumadin and amiodarone.  
Follow INR.
.
# Iron deficiency anemia: Patient will received Epo and iron at 
dialysis.

# CAD: Continue atenolol

# Hypothyroidism: Continue synthroid
